items.title: Decide how a migrated keys::Action leaves the enum without bypassing the Typing guard (E-024 is blocked on this)
items.evidence: Decided by the developer 2026-10-22: actions name their operation. A keys::Action counts as migrated when its binding dispatches a registered operation, checked mechanically (the action names its operation id; the parity test verifies the id against the registry and that the UI path dispatches it). The Typing guard stays, because the action stays in keys::Action. The parity test's definition of 'migrated' changes accordingly, and the allowlist keeps shrinking: lower UNMIGRATED_MAX by one per migrated action. the_allowlist_of_unmigrated_actions_only_shrinks asserts UNMIGRATED.len() == Action::ALL.len() and that every variant is listed by name (operations_have_two_front_ends.rs ~400-421). Action is generated by enumerated! (keys.rs ~504-833), so a migrated action must be removed from the enum for the ratchet to shrink. Options: (a) bind the key straight from KeyboardInput in editor.rs, which must re-create the keys::Context Typing guard; (b) let keymap bindings name an operation so the enum keeps only human-only verbs. Option (b) is the design the parity rule implies. Needs a developer decision before E-024 can ship.

items.title: An agent turn that is saved but cannot be logged leaves the screen and the file disagreeing

must_fix.evidence: Found by code review of the yaw branch 2026-10-22, by reading, not reproduced. ops.rs dispatch_as commits the change (the file is saved) and then appends the oplog line; if the append fails it returns Err 'the operation was applied but the log could not be written', with the map and file already changed. placement_set_yaw's set_yaw then returns false with no Undo::Turned and no respawn, and ops_brp.rs operation_apply and sequencer.rs drive_sequencer set map_replaced only on Ok(Done), so the picture keeps the old facing while the file has the new one. Fixing it changes the commit-then-append order for every operation, so it is a design decision, not a one-line patch.

items.evidence: Fixed in cycle 5 (f8df272), in the sweep though the triad is 0 of 3. take_back() in ops.rs commits the recorded inverse through op.commit when the log line cannot be written; the refusal says 'taken back and nothing was changed', or 'still in place' when there is no inverse or the take-back fails. Failing before: a_change_whose_log_line_cannot_be_written_is_taken_back (injected unwritable log; the rename stayed). Passing after: the test; one_undo_takes_back_the_newest_change (5); a_map_can_be_renamed_through_the_registry (7); ops:: lib (4). Report: docs/loop/iterations/2026-10-23-cycle5-ca6d1ef.md
